title: A Short History of France
coverage: Gaul, Frankish state formation, medieval monarchy, religious conflict, absolutism, revolution, Napoleonic rule, restorations, and republican consolidation through the early twentieth century

title: Turkey: A Country Study
coverage: Ottoman dissolution, Kemalist state formation, multiparty competition, military interventions, secular-religious conflict, Kurdish politics, and party realignment through 1995

title: Ethiopia: A Country Study
coverage: Aksum, imperial consolidation, resistance to Italy, Haile Selassie, revolution, Derg rule, famine, ethnic movements, civil war, and regime collapse through 1991

title: Area Handbook for Argentina
coverage: Colonial foundations, independence, federal-unitarian conflict, oligarchic order, Radical Civic Union, Peronism, military intervention, social cleavages, and the 1973 political transition

title: Colombia: A Country Study
coverage: Pre-Columbian and colonial Colombia, independence, Liberal-Conservative competition, La Violencia, National Front rule, constitutional reform, guerrilla and paramilitary movements, narcotrafficking, and Uribe-era realignment through 2010
